about: Machine-readable copy of qa/standard/STANDARD.md. qa/harness/standard.mjs checks every game against this list. how: 'observe' = the harness drives the game and watches; 'meta' = content in assets/game-meta.json; 'scan' = read from the game's code; 'review' = a person must look.

checks.name: Title screen
checks.pass: The game reports a title scene (ArcadeSDK.state({scene:'title'})) or the first frame is not blank.

checks.name: How to play
checks.pass: At least 2 steps in meta, and the arcade's Help button opens them inside the game.

checks.name: Controls
checks.pass: Keyboard and touch controls written in meta.

checks.name: Pause
checks.pass: On-screen pause button; the arcade's Pause freezes the canvas, the clock and audio; P or Esc pauses where free; a hidden tab pauses.

checks.name: Resume
checks.pass: After a 2 s pause the game clock has not jumped and the game moves again.

checks.name: Restart
checks.pass: The game restarts the run itself (ArcadeSDK onRestart), without reloading the page.

checks.name: Exit to title
checks.pass: The game returns to its title itself (ArcadeSDK onExit).

checks.name: Sound
checks.pass: The arcade's Mute silences every audio context and media element, and the choice is remembered.

checks.name: Settings
checks.pass: Sound always; 3D tiers also list a graphics-quality setting in meta.settings.

checks.name: Tips
checks.pass: At least 3 tips in meta, shown on the pause menu.

checks.name: Results screen
checks.pass: The game reports scene 'over' with a score or outcome during the scripted session, or meta.features.results says where it is (REVIEW).

checks.name: Saving
checks.pass: localStorage or IndexedDB written during the session.

checks.name: Phone
checks.pass: At 390x844 with touch: no sideways scroll, DOM text at least 12 px, DOM tap targets at least 40 px.

checks.name: Stability
checks.pass: 0 page errors, 0 console errors and 0 failed requests from the game.

checks.name: Loading
checks.pass: Something visible within 1 s of the game frame loading, and the SDK ready within 20 s.

checks.name: Accessibility
checks.pass: The game respects prefers-reduced-motion.

checks.name: Arcade SDK
checks.pass: The SDK loads and says ready; the game calls ArcadeSDK.init to declare what it supports.

checks.name: Catalogue
checks.pass: Category, genre, 2+ tags, blurb, howto, tips, controls, a 480x300 tile and a 960x600 tile.

checks.name: Tutorial
checks.pass: The game can replay its tutorial (ArcadeSDK onTutorial).

checks.name: Hints
checks.pass: Required for puzzle and learning games: the arcade's hint request returns a hint.

checks.name: Difficulty
checks.pass: meta.difficulty says how difficulty works (modes, adaptive curve or age bands).

checks.name: Cheat codes
checks.pass: Eligible games list 3+ codes in meta and the game accepts each one through the SDK.

checks.name: Genre module
checks.pass: Every feature of the genre module is described in meta.features (REVIEW until a person confirms it).

checks.name: Tricks
checks.pass: Board-sports games: 6+ named tricks with inputs, shown in the pause menu's Trick list.

checks.name: Graphics tier
checks.pass: 3D tiers render in 3D (WebGL context plus a 3D engine); 2D-HD canvases are crisp at the device pixel ratio.
